name: markdown-links-as-edges
body: Markdown links between documents must become graph edges, and every link must have a representable source and target — no link is silently dropped. Under the schema a `Uses`/`UnresolvedUse` edge admits only a Function or Struct source (and, for `Uses`, a Struct target): the ingestor retains a uses edge only when the target is a Struct and the source is a Function/Struct, and an unresolved_use only when the source is a Function/Struct (src/ingest.rs:896-915) — a File is never a legal endpoint, so every link is anchored on a Struct section, never on a File. The document-root section (see markdown-sections-as-symbols) closes the two otherwise-unrepresentable cases: (a) a link in a document with no headings, or in the preamble before the first heading, originates from that document's document-root Struct; (b) an unanchored link that targets a whole document (`[x](other.md)`, no fragment) resolves to the target document's document-root Struct. A resolved link from a section (including a document-root) to another document-root or heading section is a `Uses` edge (Struct→Struct), the reference relationship between the two symbols. An internal anchor link (`[x](#heading)`) resolves to the matching heading section Struct in the same document. A link that cannot be resolved — an external URL, a relative path no scanned markdown file provides, or a fragment that matches no heading — becomes an `UnresolvedUse` edge from the originating section Struct to an `UnresolvedTarget` carrying a category (external for a URL; unknown for a dangling relative path or an unmatched fragment), never a guessed FQN. Link resolution scope (path-relative vs repo-root-relative, and links to non-markdown files) is an open design point (see the open-points note). AC: a link in a no-heading document and a preamble link each yield a `Uses` edge from the document-root Struct, and a whole-document link yields a `Uses` edge to the target document's document-root Struct — no link omitted; a two-document fixture with an anchor link yields a `Uses` edge between two section Structs; an external URL, a broken relative link, and an unmatched internal fragment yield `UnresolvedUse` → `UnresolvedTarget` with categories, and no fabricated edge.
